LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PennyDialogue: I've been preparing lesson plans for Jas and Vincent. Sometimes it's difficult to keep their attention, but seeing them learn makes it all worth it.$h
I'm hoping to do some reading under a tree today, if I can find the time.#$e# It's so peaceful out by the river.
Mom has been... well, mom.$s#$e#I just need to keep things tidy around here. A clean space helps me think clearly.
Have you found any interesting artifacts lately? I love reading about the history of the valley.$h
The weekends are almost here. I should try to get ahead on chores so I can relax a little.
It's nice to have a break from tutoring today.#$e#Maybe I'll cook something special for dinner.
The valley is so quiet today... I like days like this.$h
The spring air is so refreshing! I really need it after spending so much time in the trailer.#$e#It gives me energy to teach!
Spring is my favorite time of year. Seeing everything come back to life... it gives me hope.
It's so hot today. I worry about Mom, she doesn't do well in the heat.$s
I tried taking the kids to the beach today, but the water was a bit too rough.
The fall leaves are beautiful, but they mean winter is coming.#$e#Our trailer isn't very well insulated...
Sometimes I like to sit by the bridge and watch the leaves float down the river.
I've been trying to teach the kids about winter constellations, but it's too cold to stay outside for long.
A good book, a warm blanket, and a hot cup of tea. That's my perfect winter weekend.
Happy New Year! I have a feeling this year is going to be special.
Summer is officially here. I hope I can find some time to relax by the river.
The kids are extra restless today, it must be the summer heat.
I have so much grading to do today, I almost wish I could just sleep in instead.
It's so hard to wake up early when it's dark and freezing outside.
I always worry about the roof of the trailer when it rains...$s
Are you going to the Egg Festival tomorrow? I hear the hunt is very competitive.
The Luau is tomorrow! I wonder what everyone is bringing for the soup this year.
I've been preparing my costume for Spirit's Eve tomorrow. I hope the kids aren't too scared by the maze.
The Festival of Ice is tomorrow! I always bundle up, but I still end up freezing.#$e#It's worth it to see the ice sculptures, though.
You know, before we started talking, I always felt so lonely in Pelican Town.#$e#I'm really glad we're friends...$h
Sometimes I dream of leaving this valley and seeing the world... but then I think of Jas and Vincent. Who would teach them?$s
I tried making tom kha soup yesterday. It's one of my favorites, but it never turns out exactly right...#$e#Maybe one day I'll get it perfect.
I saw Mom at the saloon again last night... it makes me sad. But... having a friend like you helps.$s
It's nice outside. Sometimes I imagine us packing up a picnic and reading books in the secret woods.
You've really brought so much light to my life. I used to just read about adventures, now I feel like I'm having one.$h
I've been trying to teach Vincent some basic math, but he keeps asking about you! You're quite popular with the kids.$h
I'm knitting a new sweater. It's so cold in the trailer during winter, we have to wear extra layers inside.
I love looking at all the wild spring flowers. I wish I could grow a garden, but there's just no space by our trailer.
Sunday is usually a quiet day for me. Just cleaning up and organizing my books for the week.
Do you have any good books you've read recently? I feel like I've read everything in the Stardew Valley library twice.
The autumn harvest is so important. I hope your farm is doing well. We all rely on it.
It's the Flower Dance! I always get a little nervous dancing in front of everyone.$s
The Moonlight Jellies are so beautiful. Seeing them glowing in the water... it feels magical.
Have you set up your grange display yet? I'm excited to see what you brought.
The Feast of the Winter Star... it's a time for family. I guess mine is small, but I'm thankful for what I have.
I always look forward to Tuesdays in the spring. The valley feels so alive and clear.$h
The weekend is almost here. I should try to gather some wild spring onions if I have time.
I spend most of my Saturdays reading, but sometimes I just watch the clouds roll over the valley.
I read a book recently about a farmer who moved away from the city... it made me think of you.$h
I'm still getting used to speaking with you so often. It's... nice.$h
Mom doesn't like the cold weather approaching... I try not to bother her when she's in a mood.
You always seem to be working so hard. Don't forget to take a break and enjoy the autumn breeze.
The start of the week in winter is the hardest. But seeing you brightens my day.$h
It's so chilly today. Make sure you dress warmly on your farm!
I hope this season brings some good changes for all of us.
Autumn is here... Time to get out the extra blankets.
The spring rain is so gentle. I love listening to it tapping on the roof while I read.
Jas made a cute little pile of red leaves today. Autumn is just so magical for the kids!$h
Everything looks so peaceful covered in snow. Like a giant icing on a cake!$h
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_S: Look at all these flowers poppin' up. Makes the walk to the saloon a little prettier, I guess.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_F: The leaves are turnin' orange. Reminds me I need to pull out my thick winter coat soon.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_W: Brrr! I saw a little robin shivering outside. I nearly left some breadcrumbs for it.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PennyDialogue: Starting the week off right with a good book. Have you read anything interesting?
Do you ever wonder what it would be like to live out far away? I read they have very different customs.
Midweek already... time flies when you're busy teaching.
I helped Jas with some crafts today. She's so creative!$h
I'm looking forward to a quiet evening tonight. Just me and my thoughts.
Saturday is my favorite day to tidy up. It feels good to start the weekend with a clean space.
Sunday mornings are meant for a slow cup of tea and a peaceful walk.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_S: Ah, spring. My favorite part is the fresh parsnips. Make sure you grow plenty.
The valley's startin' to thaw out. Guess I should think about helpin' Penny with the spring cleanin'... not today, though.
I caught Penny scrubbing the trailer from top to bottom again this morning. The girl works too hard.
Gus was tellin' me about a new dish he's tryin' out. I just go for the drinks, honestly.
End of the week... well, it's all the same to me. As long as the Saloon is open.
Saturday mornin'. The trailer's always so noisy with the birds outside. Wish they'd keep it down.
Sunday... a good day to do absolutely nothing. Wish Penny would take a break too, she works herself to the bone.
It's scorching today. Nothing hits the spot quite like a cold Pale Ale in this weather.
Too hot to do anything today. The AC in this trailer is barely sputterin' out any cold air.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_F: The cold air makes my joints ache. Gus better have the fireplace going tonight.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_R: Yoba, I hate when it rains. The trailer gets this... damp smell that just won't wash out.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_S: Glad the Egg Festival is over. Standing around in the sun trying to be social ain't my idea of a good time.
You ever think about leaving the valley? Course not, you got a whole farm to run. Us regular folks don't have it so easy.
The heat is already startin' to bother me. Reminds me, need to tell Gus to stock up on the cold stuff.
Did you see what they put in the soup yesterday? Guess it turned out fine, but I prefer my liquids fermented.
Those glowing jellies are coming to the beach tomorrow. Suppose I'll drag myself down to see 'em, for Penny's sake.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_F: Ah, Fall. Best part is it ain't hot anymore. And the Saloon starts servin' roasted chestnuts.
Setting up for the Stardew Valley Fair takes a lot out of a person. And I ain't even the one settin' it up.
Tomorrow's Winter. Tell you what, the cold is horrible for my joints, but at least folks aren't constantly buggin' me.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_W: Winter's officially here. The trailer's draftier than a sieve. Gotta wear two layers just to sit on my own couch.
Middle of winter and nothing to do. The bus sits in the cold, I sit in the cold. Makes you thirsty, don't it?
Feast of the Winter Star tomorrow. Yoba knows I don't have much to give, but Penny usually makes something nice for it.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_G: Mondays used to mean something when I was driving the route every week. Now? It's just another day.
Got a headache today. Keep your voice down, okay?
Sometimes I look at my trailer and think... well, it ain't a palace, but it keeps the rain off my head.
Don't judge me just because I like to relax with a drink at the Saloon. Gus is a good listener.
Weekend's coming up. Might buy Penny a little something from the store if I have spare G's. Don't tell that.
Yoba gives us trials. It's up to us to push through 'em.
Sunday is a day of rest, so let me rest, alright?
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_S: I used to hate Wednesdays, but knowin' there are good folks like you in the valley makes it a bit better.
It's so hot today. You better stay hydrated if you're out workin' on that farm all day.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_F: Gus usually makes something hearty on Fridays in the fall. You should stop by the saloon tonight.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_W: Ice on the roads, ice on the trailer. Winter's rough, but having a cold beer kinda numbs it.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_S: Fifth of Spring already. Used to be I'd have the bus running like clockwork. Now I just sit around waitin' for Yoba to answer.
My head is pounding. Do me a favor and talk quiet.
End of the week. Not that it matters when you're outta work.
This heat is awful. I'd give anything for a cold Pale Ale.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_F: Leaves are falling everywhere. Just means more stuff for Penny to clean up.
LucyTheDove.PennyExpansion_PamDialogue_W: Don't track snow into the trailer. I just mopped.
